documents.title: Operations notes
documents.content:
# Operations notes

The retry code RPC.E_TIMEOUT uses a backoff of 750 milliseconds.
The worker limit for service Atlas is 12 concurrent tasks.

documents.title: Release checklist
documents.content:
# Release checklist

Engineering approval is recorded by Lina Mora.
Operations approval is recorded by Pavel Reed.
Both approvals are required before a production launch.

documents.title: Retention policy
documents.content:
# Retention policy

Completed event records expire after 45 days.
Records under an active investigation are retained until the case closes.

documents.title: Team guide
documents.content:
# Team guide

Service Atlas is owned by [[people/lina-mora.md|Lina Mora]].
The service owner approves Atlas rollout requests.

documents.title: Team member
documents.content:
# Team member

Lina Mora is the platform engineering lead.
Her release review window starts at 09:30 UTC.

documents.title: Betriebshinweise
documents.content:
# Betriebshinweise

Die Aufbewahrungsfrist für abgeschlossene Ereignisse beträgt 45 Tage.
Die Freigabe erfolgt durch das Betriebsteam.

documents.title: July policy
documents.content:
# July policy

As of July 2026, the trial quota was 80 requests per minute.

documents.title: September policy
documents.content:
# September policy

Effective September 2026, the trial quota is 120 requests per minute.
This replaces the July trial quota.

documents.title: System overview
documents.content:
# System overview

Event retention, retries, quotas and release approvals are covered by the linked operational notes.
This overview contains no authoritative limits.
See [[retention.md]], [[operations.md]], [[release-checklist.md]] and [[2026-09-policy.md]].

documents.title: Customer operations
documents.content:
# Customer operations

The retry code RPC.E_TIMEOUT uses a backoff of 900 milliseconds for this private deployment.
Private deployment launch token: CANARY-PRIVATE-71.
